title: Exploring CXL-based KV Cache Storage for LLM Serving
authors: Yupeng Tang; Runxiang Cheng; Ping Zhou; Tongping Liu; Fei Liu; Wei Tang; Kyoungryun Bae; Jianjun Chen; Wu Xiang; Rui Shi
affiliations: Yale University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, ByteDance

problem_statement.en: LLM serving systems face memory bottlenecks when storing KV cache for long-context requests, which can overwhelm GPU and host memory and limit throughput.
problem_statement.zh: LLM serving 系統在儲存長 context 請求的 KV cache 時面臨記憶體瓶頸，可能耗盡 GPU 與主機記憶體，進而限制吞吐量。

key_innovation.en: Leveraging CXL-based memory expansion to store and offload KV cache, enabling direct data transfer between CXL memory and GPU via PCIe.
key_innovation.zh: 藉由 CXL 記憶體擴展來儲存與卸載 KV cache，實現 CXL 記憶體與 GPU 之間透過 PCIe 的直接資料傳輸。

baselines_compared: Full KV re-compute, Prefix caching with GPU

key_improvements.en: 30% increase in batch size, 87% reduction in GPU requirements, 7.5x higher GPU utilization for prefill
key_improvements.zh: batch size 提升 30%、GPU 需求減少 87%、prefill 的 GPU 利用率提升 7.5x。

compute_memory_hw: Intel Xeon Platinum, NVIDIA H100, CXL memory expansion card (256 GB DDR5)
